jurisdiction_name: NFLD VILL WARD C (NORTHFIELD VILLAGE Village)
narrative: Nfld Vill Ward C (Village of Northfield Village) has 549 registered voters, with 57.2% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 18.0% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 24.8%, a clear Democratic lean of 6.7 percentage points.
